consequence.statement: The `s3.sse-encryption` configuration setting is no longer honoured; environments must migrate to `sse.type` to explicitly configure SSE type.

assertion.statement: The `s3.sse-encryption` configuration key is removed in Loki 3.0.0; use `sse.type` instead to configure SSE type, as AWS now defaults encryption of all buckets to SSE-S3.
